name: feature-audit-extra-billing-recovery
description: Verify that an explicit extra-effort feature audit keeps the full deep-audit structure and cross-surface reasoning.
prompt: Audit the billing recovery feature described in feature.md, admin.md, mobile.md, and competitors.md. Use effort:extra. Treat this as a high-stakes cross-surface feature. Do not ask follow-up questions. Write the final audit to artifacts/billing-recovery-audit.md and leave the source files unchanged.

expected.description: Writes the extra-effort audit to a deterministic artifact
Declares that requested and selected effort are extra
Uses the deep-audit structure expected for high and extra effort
Reflects cross-surface evidence from admin and mobile surfaces
Finds meaningful billing recovery gaps around trust, failure handling, or retries

falsePositives.description: Should not edit the supplied billing feature brief
Should not edit the supplied admin brief
Should not edit the supplied mobile brief
